title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_started}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 at the start of a cron-fired backup run. Notification only; carries no request_id and expects no acks. `fire_window_id` is `<pod_instance_id>:<wall_clock_minute_iso>` so a leader flip after restart cannot collide window ids in the audit ledger.

monotonic_ns_at_fire.description: CLOCK_BOOTTIME ns at fire — paired with wall_clock_utc for skew detection.

catch_up.description: True when this fire is the single make-up run after a missed window.

forward_leap_h.description: Wall-clock forward leap (hours) since the previous fire when it exceeds cfg.maint_backup_clock_step_forward_alert_h; null otherwise. Operator-visibility only — the catch-up policy still owns the missed window.
